prompt.text:
Generate a professional headshot portrait for a Principal Software Engineer portfolio. The subject is Hussain, a male Android developer from Pakistan with expertise in Kotlin and mobile development.

Appearance:
- Small, well-groomed beard
- Professional, confident demeanor
- Late 20s to early 30s
- Pakistani ethnicity
- Natural, unaltered facial features

Attire:
- Navy blue casual polo shirt
- Small Android logo subtly placed on the polo (chest area)
- Clean, professional tech casual style

Expression & Pose:
- Confident, friendly expression with slight smile
- Direct eye contact with camera
- Professional demeanor suitable for tech industry
- Approachable and competent appearance

Lighting & Photography:
- Well-lit, professional photography lighting
- Soft, natural lighting (avoiding harsh shadows)
- Sharp focus on face
- Shoulders and upper chest visible (not just face)
- Modern, clean aesthetic
- NO filters, NO alterations, NO distortions
- Natural, realistic rendering

Background options:
- Option 1: Solid Android green (#3DDC84) background
- Option 2: White/light gray minimalist background
- Option 3: Subtle gradient from Android green (#3DDC84) to darker green (#1B5E20)
- Option 4: Transparent/removable background (preferred)

Technical specs:
- High quality, photorealistic rendering
- Square aspect ratio (1:1)
- Professional headshot composition
- Suitable for LinkedIn, portfolio websites, and business profiles
- Natural skin tones and realistic details
- Maintain natural proportions, no distortion

Style: Professional corporate headshot, modern tech industry casual, clean and approachable. Similar to LinkedIn profile photos of senior software engineers at tech companies.

option_1.description: Photorealistic professional headshot with solid background

option_2.description: Professional illustrated avatar in modern corporate style

option_3.description: Clean geometric avatar with letter 'H' on Android green background
